mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the capillary sprout was most worthwhile: seeing blood flow through the joined vessels made the new supply’s purpose clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the supporting fibres and then fitting them into the wound felt a little repetitive, although the picture showed why they still needed to be placed.

surprise.text: Closing the surface did not finish the repair; the tissue underneath still needed support and a blood supply.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and named slots gave each action a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter to see how the body changes over time, especially since this repair ends with a scar that will keep changing. The separate preparation and fitting steps were a little repetitive, though.
